expected.path_notes: The first day utterance is "next week", which the product cannot resolve, so ASK_DAYS re-asks once. The second utterance is "day after tomorrow", which extract_days resolves to a concrete weekday, and the first slot on that day is booked. The expected weekday is whatever day_after_tomorrow resolves to at run time; the card is valid only when that day carries Dr. Meera Rao slots (monday, wednesday, friday or saturday).
